name: CII Supply Chain and Logistics Excellence (SCALE) Awards 2026
fit: Present a measurable ambient warehousing or transportation improvement.
next_step: Ask CII whether nominations are still accepted and check categories and fees.

name: 8th FICCI Road Safety Awards 2026
fit: A transportation safety case may fit if fleet operations are eligible under the award rules.
next_step: Confirm categories, nomination deadline, fees and whether logistics operators can enter.

name: CII SCALE Awards 2027 watch
fit: Prepare a 3PL case with customer outcomes and before-and-after metrics.
next_step: Watch CII for the 2027 edition and nomination rules.

name: CII IQ National 5S Excellence Competition watch
fit: Present a warehouse 5S case with before-and-after evidence. The 2026 edition included logistics and warehousing.
next_step: Watch for the next competition brochure and check corporate eligibility and fees.

name: ET Edge Enterprise Supply Chain Excellence Awards watch
fit: Show measurable digitisation, reliability or sustainability gains in 3PL operations.
next_step: Check the 2027 call and budget for entry fees if applicable. The 2026 edition charged per entry.

name: Logistics Shakti Summit & Awards watch
fit: Logistics operations, transport innovation or infrastructure leadership case.
next_step: Monitor the organizer for a current nomination cycle, award criteria and fees.

name: TEDxGateway speaker nomination
fit: Pitch an idea with public relevance, such as how invisible logistics infrastructure helps small businesses grow. Use an evidence-led story.
next_step: Use the organizer nomination route and confirm the edition and selection timeline.

name: Delhi NCR TEDx organizer outreach
fit: CEO talk on the hidden work behind reliable delivery and its impact on communities.
next_step: Find a licensed local TEDx edition that accepts nominations, then contact its organizer.

name: IIM Nagpur ICLSCM practitioner submission
fit: Present an original operations case. The programme includes Best Paper awards. Check award eligibility for practitioner work.
next_step: Verify the submission deadline, registration fee and award criteria before preparing an abstract.

name: CII National Competition on Low Cost Automation watch
fit: Enter a low-cost scanning, picking or dispatch automation project with measured productivity gains.
next_step: Ask CII about the next competition, logistics eligibility and presentation format.
